'''Nyna Calixte's apartment''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[138 ABY]], sometime after the [[Mission to Korriban (Second Imperial Civil War)|rescue]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] [[Morlish Veed]] spent the night there with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]].

Not long after Veed discovered that Moff Calixte was in fact [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Spy/Legends|spy]], he entered her apartment pretending that he thought [[Konrad Rus]], head of the [[Imperial Mission]], was the spy and offered Calixte a drink to celebrate. However, she quickly discovered the drink was poisoned and the two began shooting at each other. The conflict ended when Calixte fell from her balcony seemingly to her [[Death/Legends|death]].
